text.id: Decentralizing tech training in Kenya and positioning youth for leading tech roles

In 2022, UNDP Kenya partnered with Lake Hub, a local tech hub, to develop and pilot an e-commerce platform to connect informal women market vendors to the digital economy. The e-commerce platform dubbed Chichwa was launched in June with over 100 vendors successfully onboarded and selling their fresh produce, artisanal goods, and second-hand clothing since then.

text.id: Building enterprise-ready skills through real-world, production-level engineering projects
Gaining continuous career growth through lifelong mentorship from industry experts
Graduates achieve an 88% tech placement rate within six months through direct matching and interview training
Build lifelong confidence and network connections within a collaborative, supportive peer community

Malika Asman joined Zone01 Kisumu with no coding background and, in roughly 18 months, turned that blank slate into a portfolio of real-world products and global open-source contributions.
